name: Rob Roy Glacier Track
region: Matukituki Valley, Mount Aspiring National Park
why: From the Matukituki valley over a swing bridge and up a gorge through beech forest to a lookout under the Rob Roy Glacier, waterfalls pouring off its ice cliffs.
book: Free. Raspberry Flat car park is 54 km from Wānaka on the Wanaka-Mount Aspiring Road (1 hr 20 min); the last 30 km are gravel with fords that rise after heavy rain. The start crosses private farmland.
water: Carry water for the day; there is nothing to buy past Wānaka.
dangers: Avalanche paths cross the track between the lower and upper lookouts, mostly May-November, even with no snow on the track.
Steep drop-offs along the track; do not go beyond the upper lookout.
Fords on the access road can be impassable after heavy rain.
Only a limited number of people may be on the swing bridge at once: wait your turn.
turnaround: From May to November, end the walk at the lower lookout (DOC).

points.name: Raspberry Flat car park
points.note: At the road end. 15 minutes on, a swing bridge crosses the West Matukituki River.

points.name: Rob Roy lower lookout
points.note: First view of the glacier through the beech forest; the end of the walk from May to November.

points.name: Rob Roy Glacier upper lookout
points.note: In the alpine vegetation at the head of the valley, under the glacier's ice cliffs and waterfalls. Return the same way.
